name: letter_selection
description: Select a letter at a named position from a short list; matched control repeats the single letter already supplied at that position.
generator_code:
import random,json,string
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(128):
 letters=random.sample(string.ascii_uppercase,4); j=i%4; name=['first','second','third','fourth'][j]
 p='Letters: '+', '.join(letters)+f'.\nThe {name} letter is'
 c=f'The {name} letter is given as {letters[j]}.\nThe {name} letter is'
 items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+letters[j]});control.append({'prompt':c,'answer':' '+letters[j]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
